policy: Index Tier 0+1 at symbol granularity first. Warm/cold the rest. Never hot-index bitcoin-sv/*. Tier 1 was verified against live GitHub on 2026-08-29: the June 2026 migration archived overlay-services, gasp-core, message-box-client, ts-p2p and 402-pay as redirect stubs into ts-stack packages, so they are never pinned — their successors are snapshotted from ts-stack itself. overlay-topics never existed as a standalone repo. x402 is an upstream Coinbase fork, not BSV-native, and is intentionally excluded.

0.role: Core protocol / wallet / standards. Failure breaks the stack.

1.role: Critical services and libraries consumed by many apps. Only live or source-intact repos are pinned; archived redirect stubs are represented by their ts-stack successors.

2.role: Important single-domain. Warm index (docs + registry), symbols on demand.

cold_legacy.role: ShopRAG-era or archived. Lookup only, labelled legacy.
